"""Immutable oracle for the end-to-end loop test — pins calculator.add across three cases.

The loop writes this verbatim into the worktree root as the immutable oracle test; the model may
never modify it. It adds the worktree's src/ (where the model writes calculator.py) to sys.path so
the `python -m pytest` subprocess resolves the import from any cwd, then asserts add() against
three hand-derived sums — specification oracles, never read from any implementation.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent / "src"))

from calculator import add


def test_add_two_positives() -> None:
    assert add(2, 3) == 5


def test_add_with_zero() -> None:
    assert add(7, 0) == 7


def test_add_two_negatives() -> None:
    assert add(-4, -6) == -10
